an4.99:1.5: n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya,
an4.99:1.6: attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca. 2.
an4.99:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
an4.99:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti no paraṃ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti,
an4.99:2.3: attanā adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti no param adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti,
an4.99:2.4: attanā kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti . . . samādapeti,
an4.99:2.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 3.
an4.99:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya?
an4.99:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā apaṭivirato hoti paraṃ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti,
an4.99:3.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya. 4.
an4.99:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya patipanno hoti no parahitāya?
an4.99:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā pāṇātipātā apaṭivirato hoti no paraṃ pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
an4.99:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 5.
an4.99:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
an4.99:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti parañ ca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti . . . pe . . . surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti.
an4.99:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
an4.99:5.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin
